purpose: Register candidate embedding and local LLM artifacts with licence, model card and hash before any of them is used.
registration_requirements: licence identifier and its text location
artifact sha256 of the exact weights used
explicit statement that the model never receives personal data
resolved_build_mode_reason: no embedding model is registered, so dense retrieval and RRF are skipped and BM25 returns the final chunks directly
status_reason: no embedding or LLM candidate has a recorded licence, model card and artifact hash
consequences: AuthoringBuildManifest.retrieval_mode is lexical_only and says so in the manifest and the review.
The optional LLM draft step is unavailable; authoring is manual (cut order 1 and 2).
No model is downloaded implicitly to make a build succeed.
